# Pinned storage interfaces

Unmodified `js/config.js`, `js/ipfs.js` and `js/ipfs-host.js` from
DecentHead v2.0.0, commit `072a5206489d0e4a3f2576c56f8debb729d933c9`.
Included source is Apache-2.0 with the upstream LICENSE and NOTICE.
The local package marker enables Node module tests; it changes no upstream code.

Canopy uses the storage session and host contract, not the Header renderer.
Host-specific public-backup validation lives outside this frozen directory.
